summary: 1 blocking finding(s); 1 in all. Harness-only change: no app booted; harness suite, harness-eval --check, doctor and the REST paths run live on the cloud VM.

findings.title: gh REST `pr checks` reports a green PR as failed: it keeps the cancelled runs a re-triggered workflow leaves on the commit, where gh keeps only the latest run of each check
steps: In the cloud session run `node .claude/scripts/gh.mjs pr checks 160 --json name,bucket` on head 1fbafa9
Every check passed, but `body: cancel` and `PR title: cancel` (the superseded PR template / PR title runs) are listed beside their passing reruns and the command exits 1 (FR-001: gh's exit codes)
findings.evidence: .claude/scripts/lib/gh-rest.mjs:185: const checks = [ ...runs.map(...) ] (no de-duplication; gh's eliminateDuplicates keeps the latest run per name and workflow)

ran: gh.mjs pr view 160 / pr list --head / pr checks 160: answered over REST; checks exit 1 on a green head (finding 1)
